{{Top|leg}}
A '''scouting buoy''' was equipment issued to the [[Scout/Legends|scouts]] assigned to [[Echo Base/Legends|Echo Base]] on [[Hoth/Legends|Hoth]]. Scouts could tether their [[Tauntaun/Legends|tauntauns]] to the buoy.
